metadata.title: Tucatinib, Trastuzumab and Capecitabine Therapy - 21 days
metadata.indication: HER2-positive locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after at least two prior anti-HER2 treatment regimens.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.source_version_verification_method: manual comparison with current official NCCP PDF header and version-control information
metadata.legacy_internal_id_note: Stable internal ID retained to avoid breaking existing bookmarks and catalogue references; display metadata now records the explicit NCCP source version.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Tucatinib twice daily every day; capecitabine twice daily on Days 1–14 then off on Days 15–21; trastuzumab every 21 days by IV infusion or a locally approved under-the-skin injection. Continue while beneficial and tolerated, with clinician-approved changes.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

renal_input.reason: Retain exact measured creatinine clearance so decimal gaps between the source bands are surfaced for review rather than rounded into a dose band.
